from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 8 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            colored=[(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            mr0=min(y for y,x in colored); mr1=max(y for y,x in colored)
            mc0=min(x for y,x in colored); mc1=max(x for y,x in colored)
            mh, mw = mr1-mr0+1, mc1-mc0+1
            motif=[[grid[mr0+i][mc0+j] for j in range(mw)] for i in range(mh)]
            for y in range(r0,r1+1):
                for x in range(c0,c1+1):
                    out[y][x] = motif[(y-r0)%mh][(x-c0)%mw]
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-b4256743.py'; p.write_text(code)
print(p)
